dedupe_keys.name: jadro and zrnovnica karst water contaminants and risk indicators

description: This collection documents twenty-one emerging contaminants detected in the Croatian karst catchment supplying Jadro and Zrnovnica springs. The Croatian Geological Survey and collaborators analyse spring, river and borehole samples to support drinking-water protection and contaminant-source assessment. Six described Excel tables contain concentrations, detection frequencies, detection limits, chemical properties, water measurements, persistence and mobility classifications, and risk quotients. Mendeley provides the tables in one ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0. The short repository description does not establish a complete sampling calendar or continuous temporal resolution. Several hazard properties are predicted, not experimentally measured, and risk quotients depend on selected effect thresholds. These limitations should remain separate from measured concentrations. A reviewer-assessed use is checking source-water quality assumptions or contaminant-transport scenarios. model-epanet provides a related distribution-network model but does not represent karst transport directly. No archive, laboratory result or risk calculation was independently checked.
